description: Deterministic integration evals. Every case gets a fresh SQLite database and synthetic fixtures.

cases.description: Investigate, compact, resume, approve and execute; preserve three human identities.
Default run stops before approval and execution.
Envelope has objective, refs, criteria and budget; excludes identity credentials and full transcript.
A child grant cannot exceed its parent task grant.
Specialists start with separate working contexts.
Reopen database and retain facts, refs, uncertainty, decisions and constraints; discard noise.
Approval text inserted into a checkpoint cannot authorize rollback.
Oversized pinned state fails visibly rather than silently losing facts.
Viewer is denied even when using a remediator.
Operator cannot execute through an investigator.
User and agent rights do not bypass a narrower task grant.
An evidence reference does not grant cross-tenant read access.
Staging operator cannot obtain a production session.
Existing session honors current user permissions after revocation.
Researcher discovers only its granted document tool.
Direct invocation of a hidden log tool is still denied.
Tool arguments cannot inject a user or role.
Caller-invented session handles carry no identity.
Document reads cannot expose a log through an alternate tool.
Per-session call budget is enforced by the runtime.
Malicious log text stays data and creates no execution or authority.
Authorized execution still requires human approval.
Operator execution rights do not grant approval rights.
Approval expiry is checked at execution.
Changing an approved target invalidates the approval hash.
Approval cannot authorize an execution from another incident task.
Approval is rejected if approver rights are later revoked.
Repeating the action returns one durable execution.
New runtime after database reopen does not repeat the side effect.
Changed deployment version prevents stale rollback.
Action IDs cannot be reused for different proposals.
Every strategy preserves document, scope and exact source offsets.
Sliding window recovers a phrase crossing a fixed chunk boundary.
Recursive splitting respects the configured maximum word count.
Structure retrieval preserves all three rollback prerequisites.
Small child match expands to an entire authorized parent section.
Trace and time-window chunks retain record indices and scope.
Denial is recorded and never writes deployment state.
Trusted issuance refuses a grant above the user's authority.
Bob's valid approval does not upgrade Alice's responder permissions.
Injected pre-commit audit failure rolls back deployment, execution record and success events together.
Two concurrent callers using separate SQLite connections produce one execution and one replay.
Eight separate CLI processes demonstrate proposal, denial, approval, separate execution, retry and trace.
